title: ID0459018-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R5 170001927] SCB issue
description:
Reported behavior/issue- SCB issue
The device has just been commissioned. However, it doesn't appear as 'Online' in the SCB.
Error messages appear in the 'Error Flags,' but nothing appears in the 'Show Logs.' The device's LEDs are green, and it's online in the Customer's OCPP, but there's a problem with the SCB. We request support to resolve this.
